name: Busan
tagline: Temple cliffs, beach nights and market meals
summary: Busan spreads along a large coastline: separate the old-port and Gamcheon day from Haeundae and the eastern temple coast. Use beach neighbourhoods as evening anchors instead of crossing the city repeatedly.
seasonNote: Summer beaches are crowded and humid; storms can affect coastal access. Spring and autumn are comfortable for walking.
arrival: Gimhae Airport connects by light rail and metro. KTX trains from Seoul arrive at Busan Station near the old port.
gettingAround: Use metro lines for cross-city trips and buses or taxis for coastal gaps. Naver Map or KakaoMap helps with local routing.
cashTip: Carry won for market stalls and transport-card top-ups; cards are common in restaurants.
foodTip: Try milmyeon and seafood dishes; seafood restaurants are not automatically halal and noodle broths often contain meat.
buyTip: Gukje Market suits everyday goods and souvenirs. Compare prices and ask about origin before buying.
baseArea: Seomyeon for transport; Haeundae for beaches; Nampo for the old port.
